✨ IT’S A WRAP! A SUCCESSFUL FANPROJECT! ✨
 Our hearts are full and our love for Rabin and Angela has reached new heights—literally and globally! 🌍💡💫

From EDSA Guadalupe, C5 Kalayaan, Cebu, Davao City, Gateway Mall, all the way to Toronto, Canada, and the iconic Times Square, New York, our eight LED fan projects have lit up the skies with one powerful message: 💖 We believe in Rabin and Angela. 💖

What began as a spark of inspiration turned into a global showcase of love, support, and dedication. 💖
 Thanks to the unwavering efforts of RabGel Kulties, we proudly pulled off EIGHT LED fan projects for our beloved Rabin and Angela—lighting up some of the most iconic and high-traffic locations both here and abroad! 🌎

To everyone who contributed, cheered us on, or simply believed this was possible—THANK YOU. 🩷🩵
 This project was made by the fans, for the fans, and most importantly, for Rabin and Angela.
